title: The Bangkok map: Thonburi is city now, with green
kaylee: Out west and down south the board is city like the real Bangkok from the air: streets and roofs, with gardens and big trees speckled through them. The farmland is gone, except Bang Mot's one orange orchard.

pictures.title: Thonburi, the part you circled
pictures.caption: Striped fields become streets and rooftops, with gardens and trees thickest along the khlongs and toward the edge

pictures.title: The whole board on an iPhone
pictures.caption: The middle of town is unchanged; the south past the river's loop got the same leafy-city look
